sentences.text: This petition was called on for hearing today.

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DIPANKAR DATTA  For Petitioner(s) Mr. S. K. Kulkarni, Adv.
 Mr. M. Gireesh Kumar, Adv.

 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner.

3. Let notice be issued to the respondents on the limited ground as to whether they are ready and willing to accept the compensation for the subject land in accordance with the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013, returnable on 21.08.2023.
